raw_text: A separate infrastructure need came up: allowing SSH logins into the main machine from a Windows laptop running WSL. The default sshd configuration disables password and keyboard-interactive authentication. The user noted that the sshd_config.d drop-in location is a directory, so overrides must be written as separate files inside it. The goal is to enable remote access from the WSL environment, building on earlier notes about a Windows-WSL connection on a nonstandard port.
